blocks.orig: The Next Paradise Boutique Resort sits on one of the most beautiful white sandy beaches of Zanzibar, directly facing the Indian Ocean with coral reefs at only half a mile away. The resort is well known for its sober elegance, excellent food, and intimate and quiet atmosphere, with sumptuous rooms that are fully furnished and equipped with both air conditioning and WiFi. The 25 rooms all lie close to the beach, while you also can choose from no less than four pools for your refreshing dip. Last but least, the chef will amaze you with his Mediterranean cuisine with a touch of Swahili flavours. Next Paradise is Zanzibar’s romantic getaway!
blocks.html: Set on one of Zanzibar’s loveliest white sandy beaches, the Next Paradise Boutique Resort looks straight out onto the Indian Ocean, with coral reefs just half a mile off. The resort is known for its understated elegance, excellent food and quiet, intimate atmosphere, and its luxurious rooms are fully furnished with air conditioning and WiFi. All 25 rooms are close to the beach, and there are no fewer than four pools to choose from for a cooling swim. Last but not least, the chef will delight you with Mediterranean cooking with a hint of Swahili flavour. Next Paradise is Zanzibar’s romantic hideaway!
